units.Jeremiah 25:1: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all Judah’s people in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah,
units.Jeremiah 25:2: which he spoke to all Judah’s people and Jerusalem’s inhabitants, saying:
units.Jeremiah 25:3: In the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, and until this day, twenty-three years, I spoke to you, rising early and saying,
units.Jeremiah 25:4: and I was sending My servants the prophets to you, sending from early morning, and you did not listen or attend with your ears,
units.Jeremiah 25:5: saying: Turn, each from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell upon the land I gave to you and your fathers from age to age.
units.Jeremiah 25:6: Do not follow foreign gods to serve them and bow down to them, so that you do not provoke Me by your hands’ works into harming you.
units.Jeremiah 25:7: And you did not hear Me.
units.Jeremiah 25:8: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you did not believe My words,
units.Jeremiah 25:9: behold, I am sending and will take the clan from the north and bring them against this land, its inhabitants, and all the surrounding nations. I will lay them waste and make them a ruin, a hissing, and eternal reproach.
units.Jeremiah 25:10: And I will remove from them the sound of joy and delight, the sound of bridegroom and bride, the fragrance of ointment and the light of a lamp.
units.Jeremiah 25:11: And all the land will become a ruin, and they will serve among the nations for seventy years.
units.Jeremiah 25:12: And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will exact justice from that nation, says the Lord, and make them an everlasting ruin.
units.Jeremiah 25:13; 32:13: And I will bring upon that land all My words that I spoke against it, everything written in this book. What Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
units.Jeremiah 25:14;25:20: What Jeremiah prophesied concerning the nations, Elam. At the beginning of King Zedekiah’s reign, this word came concerning Elam.
units.Jeremiah 25:15: Thus says the Lord: Let Elam’s bow be shattered, the beginning of their dominion.
units.Jeremiah 25:16: I will bring upon Elam four winds from heaven’s four ends and scatter them among all these winds. There will be no nation where Elam’s outcasts do not come.
units.Jeremiah 25:17: I will terrify them before their enemies who seek their lives and bring calamities upon them according to the anger of My wrath. I will send My sword after them until they are consumed.
units.Jeremiah 25:18: I will set My throne in Elam and send king and nobles away from there.
units.Jeremiah 25:19: In the last days I will turn back Elam’s captivity, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 26:2: For Egypt, concerning the force of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, who was beside the Euphrates River at Carchemish and whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah:
units.Jeremiah 26:3: Take up weapons and shields, and advance to war!
units.Jeremiah 26:4: Saddle the horses; mount, riders! Take your positions in your helmets. Hold your spears forward; put on your breastplates!
units.Jeremiah 26:5: Why are they terrified and withdrawing backward? Because their strong men will be cut down. They fled in flight and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 26:6: Let the swift not flee, nor the strong man escape. Northward, in the places beside the Euphrates, they grew weak and have fallen.
units.Jeremiah 26:7: Who is this who will rise like a river, and like rivers churn water?
units.Jeremiah 26:8: Egypt’s waters will rise like a river, and it said, I will rise and cover the land and destroy those living in it.
units.Jeremiah 26:9: Mount the horses; prepare the chariots! Go out, warriors of the Ethiopians and Libyans equipped with weapons! And Lydians, go up and draw the bow!
units.Jeremiah 26:10: That day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on His enemies. The Lord’s sword will devour, be filled, and become drunk with their blood, for the Lord Sabaoth has a sacrifice from the northern land beside the Euphrates River.
units.Jeremiah 26:11: Go up, Gilead, and take resin for the virgin daughter Egypt. In vain you multiplied your remedies; there is no benefit for you.
units.Jeremiah 26:12: Nations heard your voice, and the land was filled with your cry, for warrior grew weak against warrior; both fell together.
units.Jeremiah 26:13: What the Lord spoke through Jeremiah concerning Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon coming to cut down Egypt’s land:
units.Jeremiah 26:14: Announce to Migdol and proclaim to Memphis. Say, Take your position and prepare, for the sword has devoured your smilax growth.
units.Jeremiah 26:15: Why did Apis flee? Your choice calf did not remain, for the Lord disabled him.
units.Jeremiah 26:16: Your multitude grew weak and fell, and each spoke to his neighbor, Let us rise and return to our people, to our homeland, away from the Greek sword.
units.Jeremiah 26:17: Call Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt by the name Saon-esbi-emoeed.
units.Jeremiah 26:18: As I live, says the Lord God, like Itabyrion among the mountains and Carmel in the sea, he will come.
units.Jeremiah 26:19: Prepare belongings for deportation, resident daughter Egypt, for Memphis will become a ruin and will be called Woe because no inhabitants remain in her.
units.Jeremiah 26:20: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a detachment from the north came against her.
units.Jeremiah 26:21: Her hired men within her are like fattened calves being fed within her. They too turned and fled together; they did not stand, for a day of destruction came upon them, the time of their vengeance.
units.Jeremiah 26:22: A sound like a hissing snake, for they will travel through sand; with axes they will come against her like woodcutters.
units.Jeremiah 26:23: They will cut down her forest, says the Lord God, for it certainly cannot be estimated, for it multiplies beyond a locust swarm, and they are beyond numbering.
units.Jeremiah 26:24: Daughter Egypt was put to shame, handed over to a people from the north.
units.Jeremiah 26:25: I am taking vengeance for Amon her son upon Pharaoh and those who trust him.
units.Jeremiah 26:27: But do not fear, My slave Jacob, nor be terrified, Israel, for I am saving you from afar and your offspring from their captivity. Jacob will return, be quiet, and sleep, and no one will trouble him.
units.Jeremiah 26:28: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. I will make an end of every nation where I thrust you out, but I certainly will not make you perish. I will discipline you for judgment and certainly will not acquit you.
units.Jeremiah 27:1: The Lord’s word that He spoke against Babylon:
units.Jeremiah 27:2: Announce among the nations and make it heard; do not hide it. Say, Babylon has been captured! Bel was disgraced, the fearless one; the delicate one was handed over, Marodach.
units.Jeremiah 27:3: A nation came up against her from the north; it will make her land a ruin, with no one living in it, from human to livestock.
units.Jeremiah 27:4: In those days and at that time, Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons will come together; walking and weeping, they will go seeking the Lord their God.
units.Jeremiah 27:5: They will ask the way as far as Zion, for they will turn their faces here. They will come and take refuge with the Lord God, for an everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
units.Jeremiah 27:6: My people became lost sheep; their shepherds thrust them away and led them astray upon the mountains. They went from mountain to hill and forgot their resting place.
units.Jeremiah 27:7: All who found them consumed them. Their enemies said, Let us not release them, because they sinned against the Lord, the pasture of righteousness, who gathered their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 27:8: Separate yourselves from Babylon’s midst and the Chaldeans’ land; come out and become like dragons before sheep.
units.Jeremiah 27:9: I am rousing assemblies of nations against Babylon from the north. They will deploy against her; from there she will be captured. Like a discerning warrior’s missile, it will not return empty.
units.Jeremiah 27:10: Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be filled.
units.Jeremiah 27:11: because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering My inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in pasture and butted like bulls,
units.Jeremiah 27:12: your mother was deeply ashamed—a mother for good things, last of nations, a wilderness.
units.Jeremiah 27:13: Because of the Lord’s anger she will not be inhabited and will entirely disappear. Everyone passing through Babylon will look gloomy, and they will hiss at every wound of hers.
units.Jeremiah 27:14: Deploy against Babylon all around, all who stretch the bow. Shoot at her; do not spare your arrows.
units.Jeremiah 27:15: Clap against her! Her hands were disabled, her battlements fell, and her wall was demolished. For this is vengeance from God; take vengeance upon her. Do to her as she did.
units.Jeremiah 27:16: Destroy seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle at harvest. Before the Greek sword, each will return to his people and flee to his land.
units.Jeremiah 27:17: Israel is a wandering sheep driven away by lions. First Assyria’s king ate him; later this one, Babylon’s king, ate his bones.
units.Jeremiah 27:18: Therefore thus says the Lord: I am taking vengeance upon Babylon’s king and his land, as I took vengeance upon Assyria’s king.
units.Jeremiah 27:19: I will restore Israel to his pasture. He will graze on Carmel, on Ephraim’s mountain, and in Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
units.Jeremiah 27:20: In those days and at that time they will seek Israel’s injustice, and it will not exist, and Judah’s sins, and they certainly will not be found, for I will be merciful to those left upon the land, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:21: Go fiercely against her and her inhabitants. Take vengeance, sword, and make her disappear, says the Lord; do everything I command you.
units.Jeremiah 27:22: A sound of war and great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!
units.Jeremiah 27:23: How the hammer of the whole earth was snapped and shattered! How Babylon became a ruin among nations!
units.Jeremiah 27:24: They will attack you and you will be captured, Babylon, without knowing it. You were found and taken because you resisted the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:25: The Lord opened His treasury and brought out the instruments of His anger, for the Lord God has work in the Chaldeans’ land,
units.Jeremiah 27:26: for her times have arrived. Open her storehouses; search her like a cave and destroy her. Let no remnant of her remain.
units.Jeremiah 27:27: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their vengeance.
units.Jeremiah 27:28: A sound of those fleeing and being rescued from Babylon’s land, announcing in Zion vengeance from the Lord our God!
units.Jeremiah 27:29: Give orders against Babylon to many, to everyone drawing a bow. Encamp against her all around; let none of her people escape. Repay her according to her works; do to her all she did, for she resisted the Lord, Israel’s holy God.
units.Jeremiah 27:30: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her warriors will be thrown down, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 27:31: I am against you, insolent woman, says the Lord, for your day has come, the time of your vengeance.
units.Jeremiah 27:32: Your insolence will grow weak and fall, with no one to raise it. I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour everything around her.
units.Jeremiah 27:33: Thus says the Lord: Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons have been oppressed together. All who captured them oppressed them, because they did not want to release them.
units.Jeremiah 27:34: The One redeeming them is strong; the Lord Almighty is His name. He will judge a case against His adversaries, to remove the land, and He will provoke Babylon’s inhabitants.
units.Jeremiah 27:35: A sword against the Chaldeans, Babylon’s inhabitants, her nobles, and her discerning men!
units.Jeremiah 27:36: A sword against her warriors, and they will be disabled!
units.Jeremiah 27:37: A sword against their horses and chariots! A sword against their warriors and the mixed people within her, and they will become like women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be scattered!
units.Jeremiah 27:38: She trusted in her water, and they will be ashamed, for it is a land of carved images, and in the islands where they boasted.
units.Jeremiah 27:39: Therefore apparitions will live on the islands, and daughters of sirens will live in her. She certainly will never again be inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 27:40: As God overturned Sodom, Gomorrah, and their bordering places, said the Lord, no person will live there, and no human being will reside there.
units.Jeremiah 27:41: A people is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings will be roused from the earth’s farthest part,
units.Jeremiah 27:42: holding bow and dagger. It is insolent and certainly will not show mercy. Their voice will sound like the sea. They will ride horses, prepared like fire for war against you, daughter Babylon.
units.Jeremiah 27:43: Babylon’s king heard the report about them, and his hands were disabled. Distress seized him, birth pains like a woman giving birth.
units.Jeremiah 27:44: Like a lion he will come up from the Jordan into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her and appoint every young man over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?
units.Jeremiah 27:45: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He has planned against Babylon and His purposes against the resident Chaldeans: Surely the lambs of their sheep will be destroyed; surely pasture will disappear from them.
units.Jeremiah 27:46: For at the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will shake, and a cry will be heard among the nations.
units.Jeremiah 28:1: Thus says the Lord: I am rousing a destroying hot wind against Babylon and against the Chaldeans who live there.
units.Jeremiah 28:2: I will send insolent men to Babylon; they will abuse her and ravage her land. Woe upon Babylon all around on the day of her affliction!
units.Jeremiah 28:3: Against her let the archer stretch his bow, and let the man who has armor put it on. Do not spare her young men; obliterate her whole force.
units.Jeremiah 28:4: Wounded men will fall in the Chaldeans’ land, and pierced men outside her.
units.Jeremiah 28:5: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed of their God, of the Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from Israel’s holy ones.
units.Jeremiah 28:6: Flee from Babylon’s midst; each of you save your life. Do not be cast away in her injustice, for her time of vengeance is from the Lord; He is repaying her recompense.
units.Jeremiah 28:7: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, making the whole earth drunk. Nations drank her wine; therefore they were shaken.
units.Jeremiah 28:8: Suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her! Take resin for her corruption, if somehow she may be healed.
units.Jeremiah 28:9: We treated Babylon, but she was not healed. Let us leave her; let each of us go to our own land, for her judgment reached heaven and rose to the stars.
units.Jeremiah 28:10: The Lord has brought forth His judgment. Come, let us announce in Zion the works of the Lord our God.
units.Jeremiah 28:11: Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers. The Lord roused the spirit of the Medes’ king, for His anger against Babylon is to destroy her. This is the Lord’s vengeance, vengeance for His people.
units.Jeremiah 28:12: Raise a signal on Babylon’s walls; set up quivers, raise guards, prepare weapons, for the Lord has undertaken and will do what He spoke against Babylon’s inhabitants,
units.Jeremiah 28:13: who dwell beside many waters and her abundance of treasures. Your end has truly come to your inward parts.
units.Jeremiah 28:14: For the Lord swore by His arm: I will fill you with people like locusts, and those coming down will speak out against you.
units.Jeremiah 28:15: He makes the earth by His strength, prepares the inhabited world by His wisdom, and stretched out heaven by His understanding.
units.Jeremiah 28:16: At His voice He set a sound of water in heaven and brought clouds up from the earth’s end. He made lightning for rain and brought light out of His treasuries.
units.Jeremiah 28:17: Every person became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was disgraced by his carvings, because they cast false things, and there is no spirit in them.
units.Jeremiah 28:18: They are vain, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
units.Jeremiah 28:19: Jacob’s portion is not like this, for the One who formed all things is Himself his inheritance. The Lord is His name.
units.Jeremiah 28:20: You scatter instruments of war for Me. In you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
units.Jeremiah 28:21: In you I will scatter horse and rider; in you I will scatter chariots and their riders.
units.Jeremiah 28:22: In you I will scatter young man and virgin; in you I will scatter man and woman.
units.Jeremiah 28:23: In you I will scatter shepherd and flock; in you I will scatter farmer and farmland; in you I will scatter your leaders and generals.
units.Jeremiah 28:24: I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldeans who live there for all the evils they did against Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:25: I am against you, ruined mountain that ruins the whole earth. I will stretch My hand against you, roll you down from the rocks, and make you like a burned mountain.
units.Jeremiah 28:26: They will certainly not take from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, for you will be a ruin for ever, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:27: Raise a signal on the earth; sound a trumpet among the nations. Consecrate nations against her; give orders against her to Ararat’s kingdoms from Me and to the Ashkenazites. Set up arrow batteries against her; bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.
units.Jeremiah 28:28: Consecrate nations against her: the king of the Medes and of all the earth, his leaders and all his generals.
units.Jeremiah 28:29: The earth was shaken and suffered, for the Lord’s purpose rose against Babylon, to make Babylon’s land a ruin, no longer inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 28:30: Babylon’s warrior has ceased fighting; they will sit there in confinement. Their power was crushed; they became like women. Her dwellings were burned; her bars were shattered.
units.Jeremiah 28:31: Pursuer will pursue to meet pursuer, and announcer to meet announcer, to tell Babylon’s king that his city has been captured;
units.Jeremiah 28:32: from the extremity of his crossings they were taken, and their gatherings were burned with fire, and his warriors are going out.
units.Jeremiah 28:33: For thus says the Lord: The houses of Babylon’s king will be threshed like a threshing floor ready for use; a little longer, and her harvest will come.
units.Jeremiah 28:34: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, divided me, seized me, a thin vessel. He swallowed me like a dragon, filled his belly, and drove me from my luxury.
units.Jeremiah 28:35: My toils and miseries be upon Babylon, the woman dwelling in Zion will say; my blood be upon the Chaldeans who live there, Jerusalem will say.
units.Jeremiah 28:36: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will judge your adversary and avenge you; I will lay her sea waste and dry her spring.
units.Jeremiah 28:37: Babylon will become a ruin and will not be inhabited.
units.Jeremiah 28:38: Together they were roused like lions and like lions’ cubs.
units.Jeremiah 28:39: In their heat I will give them a drink and make them drunk, so that they are stupefied and sleep an everlasting sleep and certainly do not rise, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:40: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats.
units.Jeremiah 28:41: How the boast of the whole earth was captured and hunted! How Babylon became a ruin among the nations!
units.Jeremiah 28:42: The sea rose over Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she was covered.
units.Jeremiah 28:43: Her cities became a waterless and untrodden land; not one person will live there, nor will any human lodge there.
units.Jeremiah 28:44: I will exact vengeance on Babylon and bring what she swallowed out of her mouth. Nations will certainly no longer gather to her.
units.Jeremiah 28:49: And in Babylon wounded men from all the earth will fall.
units.Jeremiah 28:50: You who escape from the land, go on; do not stand still. You who are far away, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem rise in your hearts.
units.Jeremiah 28:51: We were disgraced, for we heard our reproach; dishonor covered our face. Foreigners entered our holy places, the Lord’s house.
units.Jeremiah 28:52: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will exact vengeance on her carvings, and wounded men will fall throughout her land.
units.Jeremiah 28:53: Even if Babylon rises as high as heaven and fortifies the height of her strength, those who destroy her will come from Me, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 28:54: A sound of crying in Babylon, a great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!
units.Jeremiah 28:55: For the Lord destroyed Babylon and silenced her loud voice sounding like many waters; He gave her voice over to destruction.
units.Jeremiah 28:56: For misery came upon Babylon. Her warriors were captured; their bow is terrified, because God repays them; the Lord repays her recompense.
units.Jeremiah 28:57: He will make her leaders and wise men and generals thoroughly drunk, says the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
units.Jeremiah 28:58: Thus says the Lord: Babylon’s wall was broadened; it will be utterly demolished, and her high gates burned. Peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will perish at the beginning.
units.Jeremiah 28:59: The word the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to tell Seraiah son of Neriah son of Maaseiah when he went from Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was an official over gifts.
units.Jeremiah 28:60: Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all the evils that would come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.
units.Jeremiah 28:61: Jeremiah said to Seraiah: When you arrive in Babylon, you will see and read all these words,
units.Jeremiah 28:62: and say, Lord, Lord, Thou spakest against this place to destroy it and leave no inhabitants in it, from human to livestock, for it will be a ruin for ever.
units.Jeremiah 28:63: When you finish reading this scroll, bind a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates,
units.Jeremiah 28:64: and say, Thus Babylon will sink and certainly not rise because of the evils I am bringing upon her.
units.Jeremiah 29:1: Concerning the people of another tribe.
units.Jeremiah 29:2: Thus says the Lord: Waters are rising from the north and will become a flooding torrent. It will flood the land and its fullness, the city and those living in it. People will cry out, and all the land’s inhabitants will shout aloud.
units.Jeremiah 29:3: At the sound of his onrush, of the hooves of his feet, the shaking of his chariots, and the noise of his wheels, fathers did not turn back to their sons, because their hands failed,
units.Jeremiah 29:4: on the day coming to destroy all the people of another tribe. I will obliterate Tyre and Sidon and all the remainder of their assistance, for the Lord will destroy the survivors of the islands.
units.Jeremiah 29:5: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon and the survivors of the Anakim have been cast away. How long will you strike,
units.Jeremiah 29:6: sword of the Lord? How long will you not be quiet? Return to your sheath; rest and be lifted away!
units.Jeremiah 29:7: How will it be quiet? The Lord commanded it to rise against Ashkelon, against the coastal places, against those remaining.
units.Jeremiah 30:1: For Idumea, thus says the Lord: There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel perished from the discerning; their wisdom went away.
units.Jeremiah 30:2: Their place was deceived. Go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Dedan, for he did difficult things; I brought them upon him at the time I visited him.
units.Jeremiah 30:3: For grape gatherers came to you; they will leave you no remnants. Like thieves by night they will lay their hand upon you.
units.Jeremiah 30:4: For I dragged Esau away and uncovered their secrets; they certainly cannot hide. They perished by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and it is not possible
units.Jeremiah 30:5: for your orphan to remain so that he may live. And I will live, and widows have trusted in Me.
units.Jeremiah 30:6: For thus said the Lord: Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup drank it. And you, though acquitted, certainly will not be acquitted, for you will certainly drink.
units.Jeremiah 30:7: For I swore by Myself, says the Lord, that you will become an untrodden place, a reproach, and a curse in her midst, and all her cities will be deserted for ever.
units.Jeremiah 30:8: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent messengers to the nations: Gather and come against her; rise for war!
units.Jeremiah 30:9: I made you small among nations, easily despised among people.
units.Jeremiah 30:10: Your playfulness assailed you; your heart’s insolence destroyed holes in rocks and seized the strength of a high hill. For he raised his nest like an eagle; from there I will bring you down.
units.Jeremiah 30:11: Idumea will become an untrodden place; everyone passing by her will hiss.
units.Jeremiah 30:12: As Sodom, Gomorrah, and her neighboring places were overturned, said the Lord Almighty, no person will settle there, and no human being will live there.
units.Jeremiah 30:13: Like a lion he will come up from Jordan’s midst into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her. Appoint the young men over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?
units.Jeremiah 30:14: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He planned against Idumea and His purpose against Teman’s inhabitants: Surely the smallest sheep will be swept together; surely their dwelling will be made untrodden over her.
units.Jeremiah 30:15: For at the sound of their fall the earth shook, and your cry was heard at the sea.
units.Jeremiah 30:16: Like an eagle he will look and stretch his wings over her fortifications. That day Idumea’s strong men’s hearts will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
units.Jeremiah 30:17: For Ammon’s sons, thus said the Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or have they no one to inherit? Why did Melchom take Gad, and will their people live in their cities?
units.Jeremiah 30:18: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make the din of wars heard against Rabbath. They will become an untrodden place and a destruction, her altars will be burned with fire, and Israel will receive his rule.
units.Jeremiah 30:19: Shout aloud, Heshbon, for Gai perished! Cry out, daughters of Rabbath; put on sackcloth, be seized with distress, and beat yourselves over Melchom, for he will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.
units.Jeremiah 30:20: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim, daughter of dishonor, trusting in her treasures and saying, Who will come against me?
units.Jeremiah 30:21: I am bringing fear upon you, said the Lord, from all your surroundings. You will be scattered, each straight ahead, and there will be no one gathering.
units.Jeremiah 30:23: For Kedar, queen of the courtyard, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus said the Lord: Rise and go up against Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem!
units.Jeremiah 30:24: They will take their tents and sheep, their garments, all their equipment, and camels for themselves. Call destruction against them on every side!
units.Jeremiah 30:25: Flee far away; go deep to dwell, you who stay in the courtyard, for Babylon’s king planned counsel against you and devised a purpose against you.
units.Jeremiah 30:26: Rise and go up against a stable nation living in refreshment, with neither doors nor pins nor bars; they lodge alone.
units.Jeremiah 30:27: Their camels will become plunder and their numerous livestock destruction. I will winnow them to every wind, those shorn before their faces; from every side of them I will bring their rout, said the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 30:28: The courtyard will become an abode for ostriches, untrodden for ever. No person will settle there; no human being will live there.
units.Jeremiah 30:29: For Damascus: Hamath and Arpad were ashamed because they heard an evil report. They were distraught and angry; they certainly cannot rest.
units.Jeremiah 30:30: Damascus grew feeble and turned to flight; trembling seized her.
units.Jeremiah 30:31: How did he not abandon My city? They loved a village.
units.Jeremiah 30:32: Therefore young men will fall in your squares, and all your warriors will fall, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 30:33: I will kindle fire in Damascus’s wall, and it will devour the quarters of Ader’s son.
units.Jeremiah 31:1: For Moab, thus said the Lord: Woe to Nebo, for she perished! Kiriathaim was taken; Amath was disgraced and defeated.
units.Jeremiah 31:2: There is no longer healing for Moab, a boast in Heshbon. They devised evils against her: We cut her off from a nation, and she will certainly cease. A sword will walk behind you.
units.Jeremiah 31:3: For a sound of people crying out comes from Horonaim: destruction and great shattering!
units.Jeremiah 31:4: Moab was shattered; announce it in Zogora.
units.Jeremiah 31:5: For Alaoth was filled with weeping; he will go up weeping on Horonaim’s road. You heard a cry of shattering:
units.Jeremiah 31:6: Flee and save your lives, and you will be like a wild donkey in the wilderness!
units.Jeremiah 31:7: Because you trusted in your fortifications, you too will be seized. Chemosh will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.
units.Jeremiah 31:8: Destruction will come upon every city; no city will be saved. The valley will perish and the plain be destroyed, as the Lord said.
units.Jeremiah 31:9: Give signs to Moab, for she will surely be kindled; all her cities will become an untrodden place. From where will an inhabitant come to her?
units.Jeremiah 31:10: Accursed is one who does the Lord’s works carelessly, removing his sword from blood.
units.Jeremiah 31:11: Moab rested from childhood and trusted in his glory. He did not pour from vessel to vessel or go into deportation. Therefore his taste remained in him and his scent did not fade.
units.Jeremiah 31:12: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will send him tilters who will tip him, thin out his vessels, and cut up his horns.
units.Jeremiah 31:13: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel’s house was ashamed of Bethel, their hope, having trusted in them.
units.Jeremiah 31:14: How will you say, We are strong, and a man strong for warfare?
units.Jeremiah 31:15: Moab perished, his city, and his choice young men went down to slaughter.
units.Jeremiah 31:16: Moab’s day is near to coming, and his calamity is very swift.
units.Jeremiah 31:17: Move in lament for him, all who surround him, all who know his name. Say, How the renowned staff is shattered, the rod of grandeur!
units.Jeremiah 31:18: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, resident Dibon. Be crushed, for Moab perished; he came up against you, ruining your fortification.
units.Jeremiah 31:19: Stand on the road and look, you who live in Aroer. Ask the one fleeing and the one being saved, and say, What happened?
units.Jeremiah 31:20: Moab was ashamed, for he was shattered. Wail and cry out; announce at Arnon that Moab perished.
units.Jeremiah 31:21: Judgment is coming into the land of Misor: upon Chailon, Jahzah, and Mophath,
units.Jeremiah 31:22: upon Dibon, Nebo, and the house of Deblathaim,
units.Jeremiah 31:23: upon Kiriathaim, the house of Gamol, and the house of Maon,
units.Jeremiah 31:24: upon Kerioth, Bosor, and all Moab’s cities, far and near.
units.Jeremiah 31:25: Moab’s horn was broken and his effort shattered.
units.Jeremiah 31:26: Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the Lord. Moab will strike with his hand and become a laughingstock himself.
units.Jeremiah 31:27: Was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Was he found in your thefts, that you made war on him?
units.Jeremiah 31:28: Moab’s inhabitants left the cities and lived among rocks. They became like doves nesting among rocks at a pit’s mouth.
units.Jeremiah 31:29: I heard Moab’s insolence; he acted very insolently—his insolence and arrogance—and his heart was lifted up.
units.Jeremiah 31:30: But I knew his works. Not his sufficiency; he did not act so.
units.Jeremiah 31:31: Therefore wail over Moab from every side; cry out over the men of Kiradas of drought.
units.Jeremiah 31:32: Like the weeping for Jazer, I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches crossed the sea and reached Jazer. Destruction fell upon your summer fruit and your grape gatherers.
units.Jeremiah 31:33: Joy and gladness were boiled away from Moab’s land, and wine was upon your winepresses. They did not tread in the morning or in the evening; they did not make an aidad shout.
units.Jeremiah 31:34: From Heshbon’s cry as far as Elealeh, their cities raised their voice; from Zogor to Horonaim and Aglath-salisia, for even Nebrim’s water will become a burning.
units.Jeremiah 31:35: I will destroy Moab, says the Lord, as he goes up to an altar and burns incense to his gods.
units.Jeremiah 31:36: Therefore my heart, Moab, will hum like flutes; my heart will hum like a flute for Kiradas’s people. Therefore what he acquired perished from a person.
units.Jeremiah 31:37: They will shave every head in every place; every beard will be shaved, all hands will beat themselves, and on every waist is sackcloth.
units.Jeremiah 31:38: And on all Moab’s rooftops and in her squares—for I shattered Moab, says the Lord, like a vessel for which there is no use.
units.Jeremiah 31:39: How he has changed! How Moab turned his back! He was ashamed, and Moab became a laughingstock and an object of resentment to all around her.
units.Jeremiah 31:41: Akkarioth was taken and the fortifications seized.
units.Jeremiah 31:42: Moab will perish from being a multitude, for he magnified himself against the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 31:43: Trap, fear, and pit are upon you, resident Moab.
units.Jeremiah 31:44: One who flees from fear will fall into the pit, and one who climbs from the pit will be caught in the trap, for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of her visitation.
units.Jeremiah 32:15: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: Take this cup of unmixed wine from My hand, and give it to all the nations to whom I send you to drink,
units.Jeremiah 32:16: and they will drink, vomit, and go mad before the sword I am sending among them.
units.Jeremiah 32:17: And I took the cup from the Lord’s hand and gave it to the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink:
units.Jeremiah 32:18: Jerusalem, Judah’s cities, Judah’s kings, and its rulers, to make them a desolation, an untrodden place, and a hissing;
units.Jeremiah 32:19: and Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his nobles, and all his people;
units.Jeremiah 32:20: and all his mixed population, all the Philistine kings, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and Ashdod’s remnant;
units.Jeremiah 32:21: and Idumea, the Moabite land, and Ammon’s sons;
units.Jeremiah 32:22: and all Tyre’s kings, Sidon’s kings, and the kings across the sea;
units.Jeremiah 32:23: and Dedan, Teman, Ros, and everyone shorn about his face;
units.Jeremiah 32:24: and all the mixed populations lodging in the wilderness;
units.Jeremiah 32:25: and all Elam’s kings and all the Persian kings;
units.Jeremiah 32:26: and all the kings from the east, far and near, each with his brother, and all the kingdoms upon the face of the earth.
units.Jeremiah 32:27: And say to them: Thus said the Lord Almighty: Drink, get drunk, and vomit; you will fall and certainly not rise before the sword I am sending among you.
units.Jeremiah 32:28: And when they are unwilling to receive the cup from your hand to drink, say: Thus said the Lord: You will certainly drink.
units.Jeremiah 32:29: Because I am beginning to bring harm in the city upon which My name was named, and you will certainly not be cleansed, because I am summoning a sword against those dwelling upon the earth.
units.Jeremiah 32:30: And prophesy these words against them and say: The Lord will give an oracle from on high; from His holy place He will raise His voice. He will give an oracular word over His place, and they will answer with Aidad, like grape-gatherers. And upon those dwelling upon the earth,
units.Jeremiah 32:31: destruction comes upon a part of the earth, because the Lord has a judgment among the nations. He enters judgment with all flesh, and the ungodly were given to the sword, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 32:32: Thus said the Lord: Behold, evils come from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind goes out from the earth’s farthest end.
units.Jeremiah 32:33: And those wounded by the Lord on the Lord’s day will lie from one part of the earth to another. They will certainly not be buried; they will be dung upon the earth’s face.
units.Jeremiah 32:34: Raise a shout, shepherds, and cry out; beat yourselves in mourning, rams of the sheep, because your days for slaughter have been fulfilled, and you will fall like choice rams.
units.Jeremiah 32:35: And flight will perish from the shepherds, and salvation from the rams of the sheep.
units.Jeremiah 32:36: A sound of shepherds crying and of sheep and rams shouting, because the Lord destroyed their grazing places,
units.Jeremiah 32:37: and the remnants of peace will cease before the anger of My fury.
units.Jeremiah 32:38: Like a lion He abandoned His lodging, because their land became an untrodden place before the great sword.
units.Jeremiah 43:1: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, the Lord’s word came to me:
units.Jeremiah 43:2: Take a writing roll and write on it all the words I have delivered to you as oracles concerning Jerusalem, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah king of Judah until today.
units.Jeremiah 43:3: Perhaps Judah’s house will hear all the calamities I intend to bring upon them, so that they turn from their evil way and I may be merciful toward their injustices and sins.

units.2 Chronicles 36:16: They kept sneering at His messengers, treating His words as nothing, and mocking His prophets, until the Lord’s anger rose among His people, until there was no healing.
units.2 Chronicles 36:17: He brought against them a king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of his sanctuary and did not spare Zedekiah. They had no mercy on their virgins and carried away their elders. He handed everything into their hands.
units.2 Chronicles 36:18: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, the treasures, and all the treasures of the king and the magnates—he brought everything into Babylon.
units.2 Chronicles 36:19: He burned the Lord’s house, demolished Jerusalem’s wall, and burned its citadels with fire, consigning every beautiful article to destruction.
units.2 Chronicles 36:20: He deported the survivors to Babylon, and they became slaves to him and his sons until the kingdom of the Medes,
units.2 Chronicles 36:21: to fulfill the Lord’s word through Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land accepted its Sabbaths, to keep Sabbath. All the days of its desolation it kept Sabbath, to complete seventy years.
units.2 Chronicles 36:22: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, after the Lord’s word through Jeremiah’s mouth had been fulfilled, the Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians. He ordered a proclamation throughout his kingdom in writing, saying,
units.2 Chronicles 36:23: “Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and He has commanded me to build Him a house in Jerusalem in Judea. Who among you is of all His people? His God shall be with him, and let him go up.”
units.Jeremiah 7:3: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
units.Jeremiah 7:4: Do not put your confidence in yourselves on false words, because they will not benefit you at all when they say, ‘The Lord’s temple, the Lord’s temple it is.’
units.Jeremiah 7:5: For if you truly correct your ways and practices and truly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor,
units.Jeremiah 7:6: and do not oppress a newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow foreign gods to your own harm,
units.Jeremiah 7:7: then I will settle you in this place, in the land I gave your fathers, from age to age.
units.Deuteronomy 6:13: You shall fear the Lord your God, and you shall serve Him, and you shall cleave unto Him, and you shall swear by His name.
units.Deuteronomy 6:14: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the nations round about you,
units.Deuteronomy 6:15: for the Lord your God in the midst of you is a jealous God; lest the Lord your God be kindled to wrath against you, and destroy you from the face of the earth.
units.Deuteronomy 6:16: You shall not put the Lord your God to the test, as you tested Him at Testing.
units.Deuteronomy 6:17: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, the testimonies and the ordinances which He commanded you.
units.Deuteronomy 6:18: And you shall do that which is pleasing and good before the Lord your God, that it may be well with you, and that you may enter and inherit the good land which the Lord sware unto your fathers,
units.Hebrews 3:12: Watch out, brothers, so that none of you has an evil, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.
units.Hebrews 3:13: But encourage one another each day, as long as it is called “Today,” so that none of you may be hardened by the deceit of sin.
units.Hebrews 3:14: For we have become partakers of Christ if indeed we hold firm the beginning of our confidence until the end,
units.Hebrews 3:15: while it is said, “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts as in the provocation.”
units.Hebrews 3:16: For who, having heard, provoked Him? Was it not all who came out of Egypt through Moses?
units.Hebrews 3:17: And with whom was He indignant for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
units.Hebrews 3:18: And to whom did He swear that they would not enter His rest, except those who disobeyed?
units.Hebrews 3:19: And we see that they could not enter because of unbelief.
units.Jeremiah 6:22: Thus says the Lord: Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations will be roused from the earth’s extremity.
units.Jeremiah 6:23: They will grasp bow and spear; it is ruthless and will show no mercy. Its voice is like a surging sea; on horses and chariots it will draw up like fire for war against you, daughter of Zion.
units.Jeremiah 6:24: We heard the report of them; our hands were paralyzed. Affliction seized us, labor pains like a woman giving birth.
units.Jeremiah 6:25: Do not go out into a field or walk on the roads, because the enemies’ sword dwells all around.
units.Jeremiah 6:26: Daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth; sprinkle yourself with ashes. Make mourning for yourself for a beloved one, a pitiful lament, because misery will suddenly come upon you.
units.Jeremiah 7:30: For Judah’s sons did evil before Me, says the Lord; they set their abominations in the house over which My name has been called, to defile it.
units.Jeremiah 7:31: And they built Topheth’s altar, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not conceive in My heart.
units.Jeremiah 7:32: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say Topheth’s Altar or Ravine of the Son of Hinnom, but Ravine of the Slain; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no space.
units.Jeremiah 7:33: And this people’s dead will be food for heaven’s birds and the earth’s wild beasts, and there will be no one to drive them off.
units.Jeremiah 7:34: And I will stop the sound of those rejoicing and the sound of those glad, the voice of bridegroom and the voice of bride, from Judah’s cities and Jerusalem’s thoroughfares, because the whole land will become a desolation.

units.Jeremiah 36:9: because they prophesy unjust things to you in My name, and I did not send them.
units.Jeremiah 36:10: Because thus said the Lord: When seventy years are about to be fulfilled for Babylon, I will visit you and establish My words for you, to return your people to this place.
units.Jeremiah 36:11: And I will plan for you a plan of peace and not evils, to give you these things.
units.Jeremiah 36:12: And pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
units.Jeremiah 36:13: And seek Me earnestly, and you will find Me, because you will seek Me with your whole heart,
units.Jeremiah 36:14: and I will appear to you.

units.Hosea 1:3: He went and took Gomer daughter of Debelaim; she conceived and bore him a son.
units.Hosea 1:4: The Lord said to him, “Call him Jezreel, for in a little while I will avenge Jezreel’s blood upon Jehu’s house and put an end to the kingdom of Israel’s house.

units.Ezekiel 5:10: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.
units.Ezekiel 5:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely, because you defiled My holy places with all your abominations, I too will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I too will have no mercy.
units.Ezekiel 5:12: A quarter of you will be consumed by death; a quarter of you will perish by famine within you; a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind; and a quarter of you will fall by the sword around you, and I will draw a sword after them.

units.Isaiah 19:4: I will hand Egypt into the hands of harsh human masters, and harsh kings will rule them. Thus says the Lord Sabaoth.

units.Ezekiel 30:18: At Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I shatter Egypt’s scepters there and the arrogance of her strength perishes there. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.
units.Ezekiel 12:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 12:2: “Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices. They have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because they are an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 12:3: And you, son of man, get your belongings ready for captivity by day before them. You will be taken captive from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because they are an embittering house.
units.Ezekiel 12:4: You will bring your belongings out like belongings for captivity by day before their eyes, and you yourself will go out in the evening as a captive goes out.
units.Ezekiel 12:5: Before them, dig for yourself through the wall, and you will pass out through it.
units.Ezekiel 12:6: Before them you will be lifted upon shoulders and go out concealed. Cover your face, and you certainly will not see the land, for I have made you a portent to the house of Israel.”
units.Ezekiel 12:7: I did so according to all that He commanded me. I brought belongings out like belongings for captivity by day; in the evening I dug through the wall for myself and went out concealed. I was lifted upon shoulders before them.
units.Hosea 10:9: From when the hills existed, Israel sinned; there they stood. Will war against the children of injustice certainly not overtake them on the hill?
units.Hosea 10:10: He came to discipline them, and peoples will gather against them when they are disciplined for their two injustices.
units.Hosea 10:11: Ephraim is a heifer trained to love strife, but I will come upon the finest part of her neck. I will mount Ephraim and pass over Judah in silence; Jacob will strengthen him.
units.Hosea 10:12: Sow for yourselves in righteousness; reap life’s fruit. Shine a light of knowledge for yourselves; seek the Lord until produce of righteousness comes to you.
units.Hosea 10:13: Why did you pass over impiety in silence and reap its injustices, eating false fruit? Because you hoped in your chariots, in the multitude of your force.
units.Psalms 21:12: Do not stand away from me, for affliction is near, for there is no one to help.
units.Psalms 21:13: Many calves surrounded me; fat bulls encompassed me.
units.Psalms 21:14: They opened their mouth against me like a lion seizing prey and roaring.
units.Psalms 21:15: I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered. My heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.
units.Psalms 21:16: My strength dried up like a potsherd; my tongue is stuck to my throat, and Thou broughtest me down into the dust of death.
units.Isaiah 10:28: For he will come to the city of Angai, pass into Magedo, and deposit his equipment in Machmas,
units.Isaiah 10:29: cross a ravine and come to Angai. Fear will seize Rama, Saul’s city; she will flee—
units.Isaiah 10:30: Daughter Gallim. Laisa will listen, Anathoth will listen.
units.Isaiah 10:31: Madebena and Gibbir’s residents were distraught. Offer encouragement,
units.Isaiah 10:32: today along the way, to remain; with the hand offer encouragement, the mountain, Daughter Zion, and the hills in Jerusalem.
units.Isaiah 10:33: For behold, the Master, the Lord Sabaoth, throws the glorious ones into confusion with strength; those lofty in insolence will be shattered, and the high brought low,
units.Isaiah 10:34: and the high will fall by a sword, while Lebanon will fall with the high.
units.Judges 6:1: The sons of Israel did evil before the Lord, and the Lord gave them into Midian’s hand for seven years.
units.Judges 6:2: Midian’s hand prevailed against Israel. Because of Midian, the sons of Israel made enclosures for themselves in the mountains, caves, and strongholds.
units.Judges 6:3: Whenever an Israelite man sowed, Midian, Amalek, and the sons of the east came up; they came up against him.
units.Judges 6:4: They camped against them and ruined the land’s produce as far as Gaza. They left no means of life in Israel, neither flock nor calf nor donkey.
units.Judges 6:5: For they and their livestock came up, bringing their tents; they arrived like locusts in multitude. They and their camels were beyond numbering, and they entered Israel’s land to ruin it.
units.Judges 6:6: Israel became very poor because of Midian, and the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord.
units.Isaiah 20:1: In the year Tanathan entered Azotus, when he was sent by Arna king of the Assyrians and fought Azotus and seized it,
units.Isaiah 20:2: then the Lord spoke to Isaiah, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and untie the sandals on your feet.” He did so, going naked and without sandals.
units.Isaiah 20:3: The Lord said, “As Isaiah My servant has gone naked and without sandals for three years, there will be signs and wonders for the Egyptians and Ethiopians;
units.Isaiah 20:4: for thus the king of the Assyrians will lead Egypt’s and the Ethiopians’ captivity, young men and elders, naked and without sandals, exposed as Egypt’s shame.
units.Isaiah 20:5: The Egyptians will be ashamed in defeat because of the Ethiopians, in whom the Egyptians had trusted, for they were their glory.
units.Isaiah 20:6: Those dwelling on this island will say, ‘Behold, we had trusted that we could flee to them for help, but they could not be saved from the king of the Assyrians. How, then, shall we be saved?’”
units.Isaiah 30:1: “Woe, rebellious children,” thus says the Lord, “you made a plan not through Me and agreements not through My spirit, to add sins upon sins,
units.Isaiah 30:2: you who go down to Egypt, but they did not ask Me, to be helped by Pharaoh and sheltered by Egyptians.
units.Isaiah 30:3: For Pharaoh’s shelter will become your shame, and reproach for those trusting in Egypt.
units.Isaiah 30:4: For there are leaders in Tanis, evil messengers; they will labor in vain
units.Isaiah 30:5: toward a people that will not benefit them, neither for assistance nor for profit, but for shame and reproach.”
units.Jeremiah 38:7: Because thus said the Lord to Jacob: Rejoice and neigh aloud toward the head of the nations; make it heard and praise. Say: The Lord saved His people, Israel’s remnant!
units.Jeremiah 38:8: Behold, I am bringing them from the north and will gather them from the earth’s farthest end at the Passover festival. You will bear a great crowd, and they will return here.
units.Jeremiah 38:9: They went out with weeping, and with encouragement I will bring them up, lodging them beside water channels on a straight road where they will certainly not wander, because I became Israel’s father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.
units.Jeremiah 38:10: Hear the Lord’s word, nations, and announce it to the farther islands. Say: He who winnowed Israel will gather him and guard him like one tending his flock.
units.Jeremiah 38:11: Because the Lord ransomed Jacob and rescued him from the hand of those stronger than he.
units.Jeremiah 38:12: They will come and rejoice on Mount Zion; they will come for the Lord’s good things, to a land of grain, wine, fruits, livestock, and sheep. Their life will be like a fruitful tree, and they will hunger no more.
units.Jeremiah 38:13: Then virgins will rejoice in a gathering of young men, and elders will rejoice. I will turn their mourning into gladness and make them joyful.
units.Jeremiah 38:14: I will magnify and fill the priests’ souls to abundance, the sons of Levi, and My people will be filled with My good things.
units.Amos 9:7: “Are you not like the children of Ethiopians to Me, children of Israel?” says the Lord. “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt’s land, the foreigners from Cappadocia and the Syrians from a pit?
units.Amos 9:8: Look, the Lord God’s eyes are upon the kingdom of sinners, and I will remove it from the earth’s surface. Yet I will not completely remove Jacob’s house,” says the Lord.
units.Amos 9:9: “For look, I am giving a command: I will winnow Israel’s house among all the nations as one winnows in a winnowing basket, and no fragment will fall to the ground.
units.Amos 9:10: All the sinners of My people will die by a sword, those who say, ‘Evils certainly will not draw near or come upon us.’
units.Psalms 73:3: Raise Thy hands against their arrogance to the end, for all the evil the enemy did in Thy holy places.
units.Psalms 73:4: And those hating Thee boasted within Thy feast; they set their signs as signs, and did not understand.
units.Psalms 73:5: As though into the entrance above,
units.Psalms 73:6: as in a forest of trees, with axes they cut out her doors; together with axe and stone-cutting tool they tore her down.
units.Psalms 73:7: They burned Thy sanctuary with fire; they profaned the tent of Thy name to the ground.
units.Psalms 73:8: Their kindred said in their hearts together, “Come, let us burn all God’s feasts from the earth!”
units.Isaiah 10:12: When the Lord has finished doing all things on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, He will bring judgment upon the great mind—the ruler of the Assyrians—and upon the height of the glory of his eyes.
units.Isaiah 10:13: For he said, “By strength I will act, and by the wisdom of understanding. I will remove nations’ boundaries, plunder their strength and shake inhabited cities.
units.Isaiah 10:14: I will seize the whole inhabited world in my hand like a nest, and lift it like abandoned eggs. There is no one who will escape me or contradict me.”
units.Isaiah 10:15: Will an ax be glorified without the one cutting with it, or a saw be raised without the one drawing it? Likewise, if someone lifts a rod or a piece of wood.
units.Isaiah 10:16: And it will not be so; rather, the Lord Sabaoth will send dishonor against your honor, and against your glory a burning fire will burn.
units.Isaiah 10:17: Israel’s light will become fire, and He will sanctify him in burning fire and consume the woodland like grass. On that day,
units.Isaiah 10:18: the mountains, hills and forests will be extinguished, and it will consume from soul to flesh. The one fleeing will be like someone fleeing from a burning flame.
units.Isaiah 10:19: Those left from them will be a number, and a child will write them down.
units.2 Kings 24:1: In his days Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon came up. Joakim became his slave for three years, then turned and broke faith with him.
units.2 Kings 24:2: He sent against him the lightly equipped raiders of the Chaldeans, Syria, Moab, and the Ammonites. He sent them out in Judah’s land to prevail, according to the Lord’s word which He spoke through His servants the prophets.
units.2 Kings 24:3: Nevertheless, this came upon Judah because of the Lord’s anger, to remove it from His presence because of Manasseh’s sins, according to everything he had done.
units.2 Kings 24:4: He also shed innocent blood and filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord was unwilling to be propitiated.
units.2 Kings 24:5: The rest of Joakim’s acts and everything he did—behold, are these not written in the book of the chronicles of Judah’s kings?
units.2 Kings 24:6: Joakim lay down with his fathers, and his son Joakim became king in his place.
units.2 Kings 24:7: The king of Egypt did not again leave his land, because the king of Babylon had taken everything belonging to the king of Egypt from Egypt’s torrent to the River Euphrates.
units.Isaiah 13:1: The vision that Isaiah son of Amos saw against Babylon.
units.Isaiah 13:2: Raise a signal on a level mountain, lift your voice to them, do not fear, beckon with the hand: “Open, rulers!”
units.Isaiah 13:3: I command, and I lead them; they are consecrated, and I lead them. Giants are coming to fulfill My wrath, rejoicing and acting insolently together.
units.Isaiah 13:4: A sound of many nations upon the mountains, like many nations; a sound of kings and gathered nations. The Lord Sabaoth has commanded an armed nation,
units.Isaiah 13:5: to come from a distant land, from the farthest edge of heaven’s foundation—the Lord and His armed fighters—to destroy the whole inhabited world.
units.Isaiah 13:6: Wail, for the Lord’s day is near, and shattering will come from God.
units.Isaiah 13:7: Therefore every hand will slacken, and every human soul grow cowardly;
units.Isaiah 13:8: the envoys will be troubled, and labor pains will hold them like those of a woman giving birth. They will lament to one another and be distraught, and change their face as to flame.
units.Isaiah 13:9: For behold, the Lord’s incurable day comes, of wrath and anger, to make the whole inhabited world deserted and destroy its sinners from it.
units.Isaiah 13:10: For heaven’s stars, Orion and all heaven’s array will not give light; it will grow dark as the sun rises, and the moon will not give its light.
units.Isaiah 13:11: I will ordain evils for the whole inhabited world, and for the ungodly their sins; I will destroy the insolence of the lawless and lower the insolence of the proud.
units.Isaiah 13:12: Those left will be more precious than unrefined gold, and a human being more precious than the stone from Souphir.
units.Isaiah 13:13: For heaven will be enraged, and the earth shaken from its foundations through the fury of the Lord Sabaoth’s anger, on the day when His wrath comes upon it.
units.Isaiah 13:14: Those left will be like a fleeing little gazelle and a wandering sheep, with no one to gather them, so that each turns back to his own people and hastens to his own country.
units.Isaiah 13:15: Whoever is captured will be defeated, and those gathered together will fall by a sword.
units.Isaiah 13:16: They will dash their children before them, plunder their houses and take possession of their wives.
units.Isaiah 13:17: Behold, I am rousing the Medes against you, who do not value silver or have need of gold.
units.Isaiah 13:18: They will shatter young men’s arrows and certainly not pity your children; their eyes will not spare the children.
units.Isaiah 13:19: Babylon, which is called glorious by the king of the Chaldeans, will be as when God overturned Sodom and Gomorrah.
units.Isaiah 13:20: She will not be inhabited for everlasting time, nor will people ever enter her through many generations. Arabs will certainly not pass through her, and shepherds will certainly not rest in her.
units.Isaiah 13:21: Wild beasts will rest there, and the houses fill with sound; sirens will rest there, and demons dance there.
units.Isaiah 13:22: Donkey-centaurs will dwell there, and hedgehogs make nests in their houses. It comes quickly and will not delay.
units.Isaiah 14:1: The Lord will pity Jacob and again choose Israel; they will rest upon their land, and the resident foreigner will be added to them and added to Jacob’s house,
units.Isaiah 14:2: and nations will take them and bring them into their place; they will inherit and multiply upon God’s land as male and female slaves. Those who took them captive will be captives, and those who ruled them will be ruled.
units.Isaiah 14:3: On that day God will give you rest from pain, your wrath and the harsh slavery in which you served them,
units.Isaiah 14:4: and you will take up this lament against Babylon’s king and say on that day, “How the one who made demands has rested, and the taskmaster rested!
units.Isaiah 14:5: God shattered the sinners’ yoke, the rulers’ yoke;
units.Isaiah 14:6: having struck a nation in wrath with an incurable blow, striking a nation with a blow of anger that did not spare,
units.Isaiah 14:7: he rested confidently. The whole earth cries out with gladness,
units.Isaiah 14:8: and Lebanon’s trees rejoiced over you, and Lebanon’s cedar: ‘Since you have fallen asleep, the one cutting us has not come up.’
units.Isaiah 14:9: Hades below grew bitter on meeting you. All the giants who ruled the earth rose together for you, those who raised all the nations’ kings from their thrones.
units.Isaiah 14:10: They will all answer and say to you, ‘You too were captured as we were, and were numbered among us.’
units.Isaiah 14:11: Your glory went down to Hades, your abundant gladness. They will spread decay beneath you, and your covering is a worm.
units.Isaiah 14:12: How the dawn-bearer who rises in the morning fell from heaven! The one dispatching to all the nations was shattered to earth.
units.Isaiah 14:13: You said in your mind, ‘I will ascend to heaven, set my throne above heaven’s stars, and sit on a high mountain, upon the high mountains toward the north.
units.Isaiah 14:14: I will ascend above the clouds; I will be like the Most High.’
units.Isaiah 14:15: But now you will descend to Hades and to the earth’s foundations.
units.Isaiah 14:16: Those who see you will marvel at you and say, ‘Is this the person who provoked the earth, shook kings,
units.Isaiah 14:17: who made the whole inhabited world deserted and pulled down the cities, who did not release those in captivity?’
units.Isaiah 14:18: All the nations’ kings fell asleep in honor, each in his own house;
units.Isaiah 14:19: but you will be thrown into the mountains like an abhorred dead man, with many dead pierced by swords, descending to Hades. As a garment stained with blood will not be clean,
units.Isaiah 14:20: so neither will you be clean, because you destroyed My land and killed My people. You will certainly not endure for everlasting time, evil offspring.
units.Isaiah 14:21: Prepare your children to be slaughtered because of your father’s sins, so that they do not rise, inherit the earth and fill the earth with cities.”
units.Isaiah 14:22: “I will rise against them,” says the Lord Sabaoth, “and destroy their name, remnant and offspring”—thus says the Lord—
units.Isaiah 14:23: “and make Babylonia deserted, so that hedgehogs dwell there; she will become nothing. I will make her a muddy abyss for destruction.”
units.Isaiah 14:24: Thus says the Lord Sabaoth: “As I said, so it will be, and as I counseled, so it will endure,
units.Isaiah 14:25: to destroy the Assyrians from My land and from My mountains. They will become a trampling place; their yoke will be removed from them, and their glory removed from the shoulders.”
units.Isaiah 14:26: This is the counsel the Lord has counseled concerning the whole inhabited world, and this the high hand over all the world’s nations.
units.Isaiah 14:27: For what the holy God has counseled, who will scatter? And who will turn back the high hand?
units.Isaiah 47:1: “Come down and sit on the ground, virgin daughter Babylon. Enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, for you will no longer be called tender and pampered.
units.Isaiah 47:2: Take a millstone and grind flour. Uncover your veil, expose your gray hair, pull up your garments to bare your lower legs, and cross rivers.
units.Isaiah 47:3: Your shame will be uncovered, and your reproaches will be visible. I will exact justice from you; I will certainly no longer hand it over to humans.”
units.Isaiah 47:4: The One who rescued you said—His name is the Lord Sabaoth, Israel’s Holy One—
units.Isaiah 47:5: “Sit stricken and enter darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. You will certainly no longer be called a kingdom’s strength.
units.Isaiah 47:6: I was provoked against My people; you defiled My inheritance. I gave it into your hand, but you gave them no mercy; you made the elder’s yoke exceedingly heavy.
units.Isaiah 47:7: You said, ‘I will rule for ever.’ You did not consider these things in your heart or remember the last things.
units.Isaiah 47:8: Now hear these things, pampered one who sits confident, saying in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow or know bereavement.’
units.Isaiah 47:9: Now these two will come upon you suddenly, in one day: widowhood and childlessness will come suddenly upon you, amid your sorcery and the overwhelming power of your enchanters,
units.Isaiah 47:10: in your hope of wickedness. For you said, ‘I am, and there is no other.’ Know that understanding these things and your prostitution will become your shame. You said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no other.’
units.Isaiah 47:11: Destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it—a pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will certainly not know it.
units.Isaiah 47:12: Stand now amid your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you learned from youth, if you can be helped.
units.Isaiah 47:13: You have toiled in your counsels. Let heaven’s astrologers stand up and save you; let those watching the stars announce to you what is about to come upon you.
units.Isaiah 47:14: Behold, all will be burned up like brushwood upon a fire and certainly not rescue their soul from flame. Since you have burning coals, sit upon them!
units.Isaiah 47:15: These will be your help! You toiled in your trade from youth; each person wandered on his own, but there will be no salvation for you.”
units.Isaiah 48:17: Thus says the Lord who rescued you, Israel’s Holy One: “I am your God. I have shown you how to find the road on which you will walk.
units.Isaiah 48:18: If you had listened to My commands, your peace would have become like a river and your righteousness like a sea wave.
units.Isaiah 48:19: Your offspring would have become like sand, those born from your belly like the earth’s dust. Even now you will certainly not be destroyed, nor will your name perish before Me.”
units.Isaiah 48:20: Leave Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Announce a voice of rejoicing, and let this be heard; proclaim it to the earth’s extremity. Say, “The Lord rescued His slave Jacob.”
units.Isaiah 48:21: Even if they thirst, He will lead them through a wilderness and bring water out of a rock for them. A rock will split and water will flow, and My people will drink.
units.Isaiah 48:22: “There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,” says the Lord.

units.Genesis 19:28: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward the land of the surrounding country; and he saw, and behold, a flame rose from the earth as the vapour of a furnace.
units.Genesis 19:29: And when the Lord blotted out all the cities of the surrounding country, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out from the midst of the overthrow, when the Lord overthrew the cities where Lot lived.
units.Micah 7:14: Shepherd Thy people with Thy rod, the sheep of Thine inheritance, camping by themselves in a forest amid Carmel. They will graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of old.
units.Micah 7:15: And as in the days of your departure from Egypt, you will see wonderful things.
units.Micah 7:16: Nations will see and be ashamed of all their strength. They will place hands over their mouth; their ears will be deafened.
units.Micah 7:17: They will lick dust like snakes dragging along the earth; they will be thrown into turmoil in their confinement. They will be astonished at the Lord our God and fear Thee.
units.Micah 7:18: Who is a God like Thee, removing injustices and passing over impieties for the remaining ones of His inheritance? He did not retain His anger as a testimony, because He desires mercy.
units.Micah 7:19: He Himself will turn back and pity us; He will sink our injustices, and they will be thrown into the depths of the sea—all our sins.
units.Micah 7:20: Thou wilt grant truth to Jacob, mercy to Abraham, just as Thou didst swear to our fathers in the former days.
units.Jeremiah 38:31: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
units.Jeremiah 38:32: not according to the covenant I made with their fathers on the day I took their hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land, because they did not remain in My covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 38:33: Because this is the covenant I will make with Israel’s house after those days, says the Lord: I will surely put My laws into their understanding and write them upon their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people.
units.Jeremiah 38:34: And they will certainly not teach each his fellow citizen or his brother, saying, Know the Lord, because they will all know Me, from their least to their greatest. I will be merciful toward their injustices and certainly remember their sins no more.
units.Jeremiah 47:1: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah afterward, after Nebuzaradan, the chief guard from Daman, sent him away, when he took him in handcuffs among Judah’s exiles who were being led to Babylon.
units.Jeremiah 47:2: The chief guard took him and said to him, The Lord your God spoke these calamities against this place.
units.Jeremiah 47:3: And the Lord acted, because you sinned against Him and did not obey His voice.
units.Jeremiah 47:4: Behold, I have released you from the handcuffs on your hands. If it seems good to you to come with me to Babylon, come, and I will look after you.
units.Jeremiah 3:16: When you multiply and increase upon the land in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel. It will not come to mind, be named or be attended to, and it will not be made again.
units.Jeremiah 3:17: In those days and at that time they will call Jerusalem the Lord’s throne, and all the nations will gather to her. They will no longer follow the thoughts of their evil heart.
units.Jeremiah 3:18: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from the northern land and from all the regions to the land I gave their fathers as an inheritance.
units.Isaiah 55:1: You who thirst, go to the water; and you who have no silver, go and buy wine and rich food, and drink without silver or price.
units.Isaiah 55:2: Why do you pay a price of silver, and give your toil for what does not satisfy? Listen to Me, and you will eat good things, and your soul will delight in good things.
units.Isaiah 55:3: Listen with your ears, and follow My ways; listen to Me, and your soul will live amid good things. And I will make with you an everlasting covenant: the holy and sure blessings of David.
units.Isaiah 55:4: Behold, I have given him as a testimony among the nations, a ruler and commander of nations.
units.Isaiah 55:5: Nations that did not know you will call upon you, and peoples that do not know you will flee to you for refuge, because of your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
units.Ezekiel 34:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 34:2: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s shepherds. Prophesy and say to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, surely shepherds do not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed the sheep?
units.Ezekiel 34:3: Behold, you consume the milk, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fattened animal, but you do not feed My sheep.
units.Ezekiel 34:4: You have not strengthened the weak, restored the sick to health, bound up the broken, brought back the wandering or sought the lost. You have worn down the strong with toil.
units.Ezekiel 34:5: My sheep scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all the field’s beasts.
units.Ezekiel 34:6: My sheep scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and scattered over the whole face of the earth. There was no one seeking them out or turning them back.
units.Ezekiel 34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 34:8: I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely because My sheep became plunder and My sheep became food for all the plain’s beasts for lack of shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep but fed themselves and did not feed My sheep—
units.Ezekiel 34:10: thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require My sheep from their hands and turn them aside from shepherding My sheep. The shepherds will no longer feed them. I will rescue My sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.
units.Ezekiel 34:11: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will seek out My sheep and visit them.
units.Ezekiel 34:12: As a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud among separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and drive them away from every place where they scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
units.Ezekiel 34:13: I will bring them out from the nations, gather them from the countries and bring them into their own land. I will feed them upon Israel’s mountains, in the ravines and in every dwelling place of the land.
units.Ezekiel 34:14: I will feed them in good pasture, and their folds will be upon Israel’s high mountain. There they will lie down, there rest in good delight, and graze in rich pasture upon Israel’s mountains.
units.Ezekiel 34:15: I Myself will feed My sheep and give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
units.Ezekiel 34:16: I will seek the lost, bring back the wandering, bind up the broken, strengthen the failing and guard the strong. I will feed them with judgment.
units.Habakkuk 2:5: But the wine-soaked, contemptuous, boastful man will accomplish nothing. He widened his appetite like Hades and is like death, never filled; he will gather all nations and receive all peoples to himself.
units.Habakkuk 2:6: Will not all these take up a parable against him and a riddle for his account? They will say, ‘Woe to the one multiplying for himself what is not his—how long?—and heavily weighting his collar!’
units.Habakkuk 2:7: For suddenly those biting him will rise, and those plotting against you will awake; you will become their plunder.

final_amended_complete_triples_reread.relationship: parallel fear in judgment upon Egypt
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.rationale: Jeremiah asks why Egypt's fighters are terrified and retreating as their strong men are cut down. Isaiah likewise portrays Egyptians trembling before the Lord's hand and fearing when the Judeans' country is named.
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.source_text: Why are they terrified and withdrawing backward? Because their strong men will be cut down. They fled in flight and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.

target_units.text: Drink, you too, a fullness of dishonor instead of glory; be tossed and shaken! The cup of the Lord’s right hand has come around to you, and dishonor has gathered upon your glory.

final_amended_complete_triples_reread.relationship: parallel unburied dead upon the earth under judgment
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.rationale: Jeremiah 32 describes those wounded by the Lord lying unburied across the earth. Jeremiah 16 likewise announces deaths without burial, also denying mourning and describing bodies upon the earth's surface exposed to animals; it does not use the source's dung description.
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.source_text: And those wounded by the Lord on the Lord’s day will lie from one part of the earth to another. They will certainly not be buried; they will be dung upon the earth’s face.

target_units.text: They will die a diseased death; they will not be mourned or buried. They will be an example upon the earth’s surface, and for the earth’s wild beasts and heaven’s birds; they will fall by the sword and be consumed by famine.

final_amended_complete_triples_reread.relationship: parallel slaughter pictured through selected sheep or rams
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.rationale: Jeremiah addresses shepherds and rams, announces the fulfillment of their slaughter days and predicts their falling like choice rams. Jeremiah 28 likewise describes bringing the condemned down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats, applying the flock image to another judgment scene.
final_amended_complete_triples_reread.source_text: Raise a shout, shepherds, and cry out; beat yourselves in mourning, rams of the sheep, because your days for slaughter have been fulfilled, and you will fall like choice rams.

target_units.text: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats.
